_comment: English message catalog. EVERY key here must exist in messages_hi.json and messages_pa.json with the same name. tools/check_i18n.py enforces this.
recommendation.safe_to_proceed: No major red flags found in the checks we ran. That is not the same as a guarantee.
recommendation.review_carefully: This app shows some warning signs. Check the official source before you install it.
summary.green: This {category} app asks only for the kind of access a {category} app normally needs.
summary.yellow: This {category} app asks for some access that a {category} app does not normally need.
summary.red: This {category} app asks for more access than it needs. Do not install it.
perm.sms: Can read your text messages, including bank OTPs.
perm.call_log: Can see who called you and when.
perm.location: Can find out where you are.
perm.accessibility: Can see your screen, read what is on it, and tap buttons for you.
perm.overlay: Can draw over other apps. This is how fake bank screens are made.
perm.install_packages: Can ask to install other apps on your phone.
perm.notification_listener: Can read every notification you get, including OTP messages.
perm.device_admin: Can make itself hard to uninstall.
perm.all_files: Can read all files on your phone's storage.
perm.boot: Starts by itself when you switch the phone on.
perm.expected: {permission_label} This is normal for a {category} app.
perm.unexpected: {permission_label} A {category} app does not normally need this.
rule.many_sensitive: This app asks for many different kinds of sensitive access.
rule.mismatch: The app asks for access that does not fit what it says it does.
impersonation.detected: This app uses a name that looks like a known brand, but it is not that brand's official app.
pattern.otp_stealer: If this app is malicious, it could read your bank OTPs.
pattern.banking_trojan: If this app is malicious, it could show fake bank screens and read your OTPs.
pattern.spyware_profile: If this app is malicious, it could record you and track where you go, in the background.
pattern.dropper: This app can ask to install other apps on your phone.
pattern.device_admin_lock: This app may be hard to uninstall.
pattern.call_intercept: This app could see who calls you and record your calls.
pattern.repackaged_signer: This app claims to be another app, but it was signed by a different developer. It has been modified.
link.direct_apk: This link downloads an app file (.apk) directly instead of opening a website.
link.brand_lookalike: This link uses a name that looks like a brand, but it is not that brand's official website.
link.ip_host: This link points to a raw number address instead of a normal website name.
link.punycode: This link's address contains characters that can be used to imitate a real website.
link.at_symbol: This link's address is written in a way that hides where it really goes.
link.suspicious_tld: This link uses a website ending that is common in scams.
link.no_https: This link is not secure (no HTTPS).
link.deep_subdomains: This link's address has an unusually long chain of prefixes.
link.scam_keywords: This link's address contains a word commonly used in scams ({keyword}).
link.shortener: This link is shortened, so its real destination is hidden.
link.downgrade_redirect: This link redirects to a less secure address.
link.reputation_flagged: This link has been flagged as dangerous by an external service.
status.not_checked: We could not run this check.
status.insufficient_data: Not enough scans yet to say anything useful.
repackaging.title: This app may have been modified
repackaging.signer_mismatch: The app name matches, but the signature does not. Someone rebuilt this app.
repackaging.package_collision: This package name belongs to a different app.
update.title: Change since the last scan
update.cert_changed: The app is now signed by a different developer than before.
update.none: No new sensitive access was added since the last scan.
intel.title: Other people who checked this file
intel.body: {scans} people have checked this exact file. {percent}% were told not to install it.
intel.insufficient: Only a few people have checked this file so far.
prescription.title: The least this app could ask for
prescription.body: An app like this can do its job with only: {groups}.
calibration.title: Reasons this reading might be wrong
calibration.unknown_category: We could not tell what kind of app this is, so we judged every permission on its own.
calibration.low_confidence: Our guess about what this app does is not a confident one.
calibration.no_launcher: This app has no normal way to open it, which makes its purpose unclear.
calibration.allowlist_caveat: Some genuine apps need unusual permissions. This can produce false alarms.
disclaimer: Static analysis only. This is not a guarantee of safety.
error.file_too_large: That file is larger than the limit.
error.not_an_apk: That file does not look like an Android app package.
error.manifest_unreadable: We could not read this app's manifest. It may be damaged or use an unusual format.
error.invalid_url: That does not look like a valid web address.
error.analysis_timeout: The analysis took too long and was stopped.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
error.report_not_found: That report has expired or does not exist.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
